proposed.sourceName: Muslim Judicial Council Halaal Trust (MJCHT) — 'Flavour Enhancer E627'
proposed.paraphrase: MJCHT states E627 (disodium guanylate) can be obtained from sardines, baker's yeast or other extracts, rejects as false the claim that it derives only from non-halal animals, and holds products bearing E627 'most certainly halal' when MJCHT-certified — while counselling that 'when in doubt (uncertain) about the halal status, it's best to abstain'. For E627 of unverified origin without certification, that abstention principle applies.

proposed.sourceName: South African National Halaal Authority (SANHA) — E627 (Sodium Guanylate)
proposed.paraphrase: SANHA classifies E627 (sodium guanylate) as Halaal, listing its source as synthetic guanylic acid — the permissive side of the scholarly spread on this flavour enhancer.
